comment: Extra gain of the red, blue and overall (g) channels vs the distance from the optical centre (BDS-normalised radius 0, 0.2 ... 1.4), measured in situ with the front lens against a white PC monitor window (closed loop after the black level fix: R/G, B/G and G flat within 2-3%; g smoothed); applied on top of the Windows lens shading tables. The g profile is capped at 1.4 (calibrated 1.75): more gain at the corners made the colour noise there too visible.
black_comment: Black level subtracted by the ImgU for Gr, R, B, Gb (10 bit): measured with the lens covered at fixed analogue gain 1 and 4 (output starts to lift below these values); libcamera used 64, which crushed the shadows.

tone.comment: libcamera's fixed ToneMapping gamma 1.1 is almost linear: dark objects are crushed. Gamma 1.5 (patch ipu3-tonemapping) with the AE targets lowered to match (measured on a scene with black backpacks: 20% of pixels < 20/255 -> 1.4%, no clipping).

bnr_comment: Bayer noise reduction [cf, cg, alpha, beta, gamma, max_inf]: cf is the constant noise threshold, cg>0 makes the filter stronger as the gain rises, alpha/beta/gamma weigh the smoothing filter (Intel defaults: 1700, 0, 9, 3, 4, 8).
